question.text: Biochemical Oxygen Demand <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">D</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is the amount of oxygen required (in <math><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> ):

options.text: for sustaining life in a water body.
by bacteria to break-down organic waste in a certain volume of a water sample.

for the photochemical breakdown of waste present in <math><mn>1</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></math> volume of a water body
by anaerobic bacteria to breakdown. inorganic waste present in a water body.

solution.text: The amount of oxygen required by bacteria to break down the organic matter present in a certain volume of a sample of water, is called Biochemical oxygen Demand (BOD).
